name: 表示文字とURLを分けて挿入するリンク編集
prompt:
Create a second LH03-0158 link-entry dialog at exactly 390:212, correcting the first version's vertical placement and height while preserving its Japanese labels, empty fields, gray placeholders, and green actions.

Match these native logical coordinates:
- Outer light-gray rounded dialog: x32, y8, width326, height188, ending at y196.
- Centered bold heading 「リンクを追加」 near y30–44.
- White two-row input group: x48, y66, width294, height76. First row contains placeholder 「表示する文字」; second row contains placeholder 「リンク先のURL」. Divider at y104.
- Action area begins at y152 and ends at y196; center divider at x195. Put 「キャンセル」 at left and 「保存」 at right.

The first render placed the dialog top around y19 and made it about 9px too short. Move its top up to y8 and extend the dialog to 188px tall. Move the input group up about 6px and the action divider up about 5px, keeping the bottom edge at y196. Preserve the native horizontal positions and balanced button widths.

Both fields are empty. Keep the two placeholders muted gray; there is no entered link text or clickable hyperlink in this dialog, so do not add blue text or an example URL. Keep both action labels dark green and the title dark. The canvas is white outside the dialog. Do not include the dimmed Slack background, keyboard, status bar, icons, shadows, or extra controls. Use the native preview for exact isolated Japanese modal styling; the original Slack screenshot provides dialog semantics only.
reviewNotes: 第2版を目視。日本語見出し、2つの空欄placeholder、緑のキャンセル/保存、灰色文字を保持し、入力値や青文字は追加しない。第1版から見た目上の幾何変化はほとんどない。native 390x212に対し外枠上端は約y19のまま（目標y8）、高さも約179のまま（目標188）。入力群と下部区切り線も各約6px/5px低い。2回の限定試行後もneeds-correctionを保持し、次IDへ進む。所有者受入・編集可能性・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
